Affidavit-of-service filed by the petitioners be kept with the record.
Petitioners approached this Court being aggrieved with the progress of the investigation of Kalyani P.S. Case No.410 of 2017 dated 02.11.2017.
The case was registered under Sections 406/420 of the Indian Penal Code against one Koushik Dutta.
In course of investigation, the said Koushik Dutta was arrested on 12.12.2017.

The statement under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure of the writ petitioners were recorded and on conclusion of investigation charge-sheet was submitted on or about January, 2020 against the said Koushik Dutta.
Report further reflects that after charge-sheet was submitted, the accused was absconding.
Consequently, warrant of arrest has been issued.
Report also reflects that the next date is fixed on 05.05.2026.

Having considered that the accused is absconding and fleeing away from the process of law, I direct that the Additional S.P/SDPO in-Charge of Kalyani Police Station, Ranaghat Police District will monitor regarding the execution of the warrant of arrest.
